details.description:
Had to train multiple people to get into the Derrick for their first time.

Fausto Reyes did an excellent job stabbing.
Employee using ski ropes as required
The rig has pipe racked in the derrick and created an obstacle when swinging tongs in to the stump.
my guys cleared rig floor of all trip hazards, safe job
Estoy pena Station, To Heavy Five Careful Down What All Time and Round Stop The
There are 4 different exits on the rig floor, one of them was obstructed.
While conducting field visit, noticed utility trailer #1388PP had front passenger side running light broken. Please see attachment.
FMS tool was not working properly, Tongs would not run when hooked to FMS.
Poly crew member was wearing H2S monitor on back of hard hat.
Steps going up to puts missing keepers

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Yes, pipe in the derrick made it difficult to swing the tongs in to the stump. Crew members were using good communication while performing this task.

recent_findings.concern: Whip checks not being on hydraulic hose
recent_findings.positive: Maintained good communication with operator

recent_findings.concern: As stated in observation two hoses left without whip checks.
recent_findings.positive: Crew maintained good communication with operator

recent_findings.concern: None, all members are very observant.
recent_findings.positive: All members were communicating very well and helped each other during rig up and run.

recent_findings.concern: Only thing that was observed, was the employee standing under a suspended load. It was corrected immediately.
recent_findings.positive: Pusher and FMS operator double checked all connections before engaging the HPU.

recent_findings.concern: None witnessed
recent_findings.positive: Crew did a good job working with each other on the workover rig floor. They handled the tight work area well

recent_findings.concern: Not being aware of surroundings.

recent_findings.concern: Observed employee standing in the line of fire on 2 different occasions. Behavior was corrected immediately!
recent_findings.positive: Crew members work well together, and when one goes to get water, he brings enough for the rest.

recent_findings.concern: (Finding noted via CA/CAPA -- no narrative provided)
recent_findings.positive: Crew members were all wearing proper PPE and were doing a good job being mindful of line fire areas and pinch points

recent_findings.concern: All using proper hand placement

recent_findings.concern: None, they are doing a good job.
recent_findings.positive: Communication is very good and signals are clear and understood.

recent_findings.concern: JSA was not signed by all personnel involved, I spoke to them about the importance of discussing and signing JSA.
recent_findings.positive: Crew was working very well together on the rig floor, considering the amount of room on the floor.

recent_findings.concern: None witnessed
recent_findings.positive: Crew is all wearing proper ppe and doing a good job being aware of the hazards around them
